subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 1/5] mountd: factor out the per-path export attribute computation

2026-09-09.patch_summary: This patch refactors the computation of per-path export attributes in the mountd service, specifically pulling out the adjustments made to export flags, fsid, and uuid when dealing with cross-mount subdirectories. The goal is to make this logic reusable by both the upcall path (kernel) and downcall path (netlink). No functional changes are introduced.
